title: Cerebus Jaka’s Story 5 January #118 - Aardvark-Vanaheim ISSN 0712-7774 Dave Sim
descriptionText: Cerebus Jaka’s Story 5 January #118 is a collectible comic book created by Dave Sim and published by Aardvark-Vanaheim in 1989. This issue features the character Cerebus, aardvark, and is part of the Copper Age (1984-1991) of US Comics. The comic book is a continuation of the series titled Cerebus and is perfect for fans of comics and graphic novels. The publication year, artist/writer, type, character, era, tradition, series title, genre, and publisher are all important aspects of this collectible item.
